suspended.title: Taxpayer suspended

suspended.supportMessage:

subscription.trialBody: Your free trial ends soon. Choose a plan to keep using all features.
subscription.expiredBody: The system is locked until you subscribe to a plan. Your data is saved and will be available again as soon as payment is confirmed.

demo.title: You are viewing demo data
demo.body: The company is filled with sample data (company details, clients, products and invoices) so you can explore everything, including the ISPC calculation. When you are ready to start for real, remove it and set up the company with your real details.
demo.confirmMessage: Everything in this company will be deleted: clients, products, invoices and receipts (including the ones you created while testing), tax returns and the company details. This cannot be undone.
demo.removedMessage: The company is now empty. Set it up with your real details (NUIT, address and activity) before issuing invoices.
demo.removeError: The demo data could not be removed.

completeCompany.title: Complete your company details
completeCompany.body: Add the NUIT, address and entity type so they appear on your invoices.

offline.banner: No internet — showing the last saved data. Reconnect to create or change anything.
